overview: The Medford City Council and Community Development Board convened a joint meeting to discuss the Medford Square zoning amendments, but voted to continue the hearing to March 3, 2026, due to severe, persistent technical difficulties in the chambers.

items.title: Call to Order and Roll Call
items.summary: The joint meeting of the Medford City Council and Community Development Board was called to order following a half-hour delay caused by technical issues.

items.title: Continued Public Hearing on Medford Square Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Following a brief presentation by the chair summarizing key zoning issues, both bodies voted to continue the public hearing and adjourn to March 3, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. due to unmanageable audio and video feed issues.
